items.title: ‘Termination shock’: trust our expert warnings on geoengineering’s planetary risks | Raymond Pierrehumbert, Julia Slingo, Michael Mann and Valerie Masson-Delmotte
items.description: <p>Do we really want to play dice with our planet?</p><p>A series in the Guardian recently declared “it’s <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/commentisfree/series/it-s-time-to-talk-about-geoengineering">time to talk</a> about geoengineering.” So let’s talk about it. And let us start with some simple truths about this cluster of techno-optimistic “quick fixes” which purport to somehow offset our slow progress towards zeroing out planet-warming carbon emissions.</

items.description: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz said the European Commission's long-term budget proposal for 2028 to 2034 was "far too high" and called for a new proposal.

items.title: UK: Manchester Mayor Andy Burnham wins parliament seat
items.description: A by-election victory paves the way for Burnham to challenge PM Keir Starmer's leadership. But Starmer says, "I'm not going to walk away."

items.title: Israel says it's cutting ties to EU's Kaja Kallas
items.description: Israel's foreign minister says he is severing contact with the EU's foreign affairs chief Kaja Kallas. Gideon Saar attributed the move to a media report alleging that Kallas compared Israel to apartheid-era South Africa.
